response.overview: To add passengers to your Princess cruise, call Customer Support directly at ☎︎ +1**844~375~4179[USA] or ☎︎ +1**844~375~4179 [UK] & ☎︎ 1-844-375-4179 (UK or contact your travel advisor. Adding a guest requires available double-occupancy or extra berth space in your ☎︎ 1-844-375-4179 stateroom, plus open shipboard safety capacity. Once confirmed, you must pay the additional cruise fare, taxes, and port charges for the new guest.  Yes, you can add a person +1**844~375~4179 to an existing Princess cruise by calling Customer Support directly at ☎︎ +1**844~375~4179[USA
